events.intent: Jack asks Mara the amount by typing through his speech collar, pays cash, then privately persists in his fictional gadget operation to reach the locally detected devices, establish privileged persistent access and minimize evidence.
events.outcome: Mara charges 7.80 in unspecified local currency, Jack pays with 10 cash and receives 2.20 change. His fiction-only device operation establishes privileged persistent access to nine locally detected devices, without visible alerts in the café; his own session traces are cleared but outside records are not guaranteed erased. The shift nears closing and Mara asks Jack to leave the section in five minutes.
